cords.name: p1
cords.notes: Pendant cord #1 is tied together with cord #2 and its subsidiaries from 24-27 cm; thus, the lengths are uncertain for cords #1, #2, and the latter's subsidiaries.

cords.name: p21s1s2
cords.notes: The second 1E knot (which is the last of three  total knots) has a red thread run-through.

cords.name: p24s1s3s1
cords.notes: This cord has two knot clusters.  The second 1E knot in the final cluster has red thread run-through.

cords.name: p24s1s4
cords.notes: This cord has two knot clusters.  The 4L knot in the second cluster has white thread run-through.

cords.name: p24s1s5
cords.notes: This cord has three knot clusters.  The 1E knot in the second cluster has vegetal fiber string run-through.

cords.name: p29s1s2
cords.notes: This cord has two knot clusters.  The 1E knot in the second cluster has red thread run-through.

cords.name: p33s1s2s1
cords.notes: The first 1E knot in this cord's knot cluster has red thread run-through.

cords.name: p54s1s1
cords.notes: The two E knots on this cord contain a splice from the top of the first knot to the string just below the second knot (see illustration in original notes).

cords.name: p56s1
cords.notes: Cord 56s1 is tied together with one of its subsidiaries, 56s1s4, at the ends of the strings.

cords.name: p56s1s4
cords.notes: Cord 56s1 is tied together with this subsidiary at the ends of the strings.
